description:
I’m a Full-Stack Software Developer with 4+ years of experience designing and delivering scalable systems across backend, frontend, cloud, and AI. My core expertise lies in Java, Spring Boot, and microservices, where I’ve built resilient backend architectures, but I’m equally comfortable crafting user-friendly interfaces with React and Angular. Over the years I’ve extended my skill set into mobile development with .NET MAUI and cross-platform frameworks, as well as integrating AI and ML workflows using LangChain, LlamaIndex, and Hugging Face to bring intelligence into enterprise applications.

What defines me is not just the technologies I know but the mindset I bring. I believe knowledge is the most powerful asset a person can build. I enjoy going beyond the surface from low-level systems that power operating systems and compilers, to distributed cloud infrastructure on AWS and Azure, to the cutting edge of generative AI. I adapt quickly to new domains and genuinely enjoy exploring different technologies, connecting the dots between them, and applying those lessons to solve real-world problems. For me true growth comes from pushing beyond comfort zones, questioning assumptions, and connecting insights across different fields.

My motto is simple. *"Knowledge grows when shared, and mastery comes from never ending the journey of learning."* This belief drives me to keep experimenting, refining, and growing not just as a developer but as someone who thrives on turning curiosity into capability.
